|game_text=Deploy on table. If opponent's just lost character is about to be removed from the Lost Pile, you may lose 1 Force to imprison that character in any prison or place that character in opponent's Used Pile. If Carbonite Chamber Console on table, once per turn you may use 1 Force to ▼ any Effect. (Immune to Alter.)

|notes=The set was released 21 November 2003. The complete first sheet remains unlocated. The comparison dates each surviving issuer text. [https://web.archive.org/web/20031202154611id_/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm Players Committee release announcement]. The first surviving text can imprison in any prison or put the card in the opponent’s Used Pile. The remaster makes this capture with its imprison-or-escape choices. The alternative Effect deployment retains the cost, console condition and ordinary owner deployment timing.
